title: Cost bound for the exactly-one formula
statement: For every finite list $vs$ of natural numbers, the cost of the CNF formula expressing exactly one of the listed variables is at most $|vs|+1+3|vs|^2$, where $|vs|$ is the length of the list.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $vs$ of natural numbers
